{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("First few rows:")
print(df.head())

print("Data types:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("Missing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())

print("Customer age value counts (sorted by age):")
print(df['customer_age'].value_counts().sort_index())

print("First 10 unique revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

print("Status value counts:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())

print("Channel value counts:")
print(df['channel'].value_counts())

print("Customer segment value counts:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
